method:
Publish five sword studies from real mGBA captures, without repainting art.

Clean comparisons crop exact native PNG framebuffers, enlarge with nearest
neighbour and add labels/timing bars outside gameplay. Cyan hitbox versions
are explicitly diagnostic composites of the aligned runtime damage rectangle.
Normal GIFs sample two video frames at a time; slow GIFs retain every frame.
The MP4 is a lossy convenience copy at the recorded GBA video rate.
Compact case publication retains videos, native keyframes and traces; omitted
raw-GIF/local-frame references move into explicitly archival report fields.

publication.comparison_pixel_source: Original full-frame native PNG archive, not the omitted raw case GIFs.

profile.name: Planted slash
profile.description: A compact planted cut: small counter-turn, quick contact and a firm return.

profile.name: Broad sweep
profile.description: A hip-led sweep: planted rear root, turning chest and a broader readable arc.

profile.name: Step-and-cut
profile.description: A deliberate forward root step and diagonal cut; drawn footwork has no world lunge.

profile.name: Overhand chop
profile.description: A rooted overhead load, decisive downstroke and compressed impact pose.

profile.name: Flowing backhand
profile.description: A reverse-direction cut with a low cross-body load and a flowing shoulder follow-through.

palette_note: Raw native PNGs are unchanged. Comparison GIF metadata records whether its combined colour union fits 256 colours. Video is a lossy convenience.

controlled_targets.method: Real sword contacts against ordinary engine-spawned beetles on natural terrain. Target AI/position are disclosed fixtures, native HP and actual contact reactions are retained.

video.method: Actual native PNG crops enlarged 3x, labels/timing bars outside gameplay; two native-timing cycles and one 3x slow cycle per facing. Silent lossy convenience copy.
